text: D2a opened. QD1-001 read again (J, 21:19 Berlin: an element may sit in two or more dimensions; the check was wrong); it was revisited and closed at D1a, and nothing in D2 rests on my assumption. validate.py --open D2 names two inputs MISSING that are present under other paths: EXPECTATIONS.jsonl is sealed in out/sealed/ (stage D2 forbids reading it against the ledger; E1 does), and model-D.md is per room (out/rooms/<sub>/model-D.md, with run.json and verdict-D.jsonl). DROPS/D/DONE and UNRETURNED.tsv are present. No .pause. PI's recap read: 705 rooms returned, 0 unreturned; 1,410 verdict returns, 32 reissues; readers DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at medium; labelers resumed on GPT-5.6 medium, switched to GPT-6.1 medium before the return task; 378 rooms needed one to four same-session repairs; no second labeler set. Next: section 1, ingest-D.md.

D2a section 1, the ingest report read (ingest-D.md, 08:53:27) and checked by count (_analysis/d2_ingest.py; the ledger read by count, never as a list). 705 rooms returned and accepted, 0 rejected, 0 unreturned (DONE: returned 705, unreturned 0; UNRETURNED.tsv header only), 0 reissued; RUN.json D2 {accepted 705, reissued 0, unreturned 0} matches the report and the ledger. 'Reissued' counts run.json attempts above 1; every room has attempts 1, so the 378 rooms the handler repaired in the same session (PI's recap) do not count as reissues, and the repairs and the rules they fixed are not in any file I may read. 42,243 lines; per room min 21, median 60, p90 68, max 91. Ops: instantiate 17,648, absent 14,675, restrict 4,406, add-step 1,889, add-condition 1,408, propose 1,362, link 844, contradict 11 (P13 5, P10 3, A10, A04, A07 1 each). The rule that flagged most lines: portability (rule 5), the only flag ingest keeps in the ledger: 763 lines non-portable (1.81%) in 356 rooms, 169 of them naming the room itself; every other rule rejects a room whole, and none was rejected at compile. None rooms 0. Unplaced source: 134 of 27,571 sourced lines (0.5%) in 98 rooms, 61 of them propose lines. The labelers: gpt-6.1-sol in all 705 run.json copies, resumed with gpt-5.6-sol. Every model-D.md grades composes-with-residue (703 bare, 2 with a sentence on the line) and every local_status is unresolved: the labelers' grade does not vary.

D2a section 2, the verdicts (_analysis/d2_verdicts.py; split rooms in _analysis/d2_verdict_rooms.json). 705 rooms, 1,410 reader lines, two per room (r1 686, r2 693, 31 from reissued readers); served deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, verified, medium effort; 1,442 attempts, 32 invalid (24 lacked served, 6 lacked the end marker, 1 misspelled a verdict) and reissued, 0 exhausted, cost USD 13.03. Reader verdicts: composes-with-residue 927, composes 432, cannot-tell 49, does-not-compose 2. Rooms: both readers agree in 542 (with-residue 387, composes 140, cannot-tell 14, does-not-compose 1: picturegame); 163 split, a disagreement rate of 23.1%: composes against with-residue 142, cannot-tell against with-residue 11, cannot-tell against composes 10; no split runs to does-not-compose. This figure bounds whether the written criterion decides a room, not whether the model is right. Cannot-tell by threshold: coded-share 39, off-platform 10, both 0; every one is supported by the room's numbers against prior.md section 8 (below the floor of 10, or past the off-platform threshold), so no cannot-tell line goes to D3 as unsupported. The labeler's grade is composes-with-residue in all 705 rooms, so the cross-table has one row: with-residue by room verdict composes 140, with-residue 387, does-not-compose 1, cannot-tell 14, split 163. Return-line facts: 1,409 of 1,410 served values equal the value the packet states (ducks r1 dropped two characters); 225 reader lines wrote the room's name differently in sub (185 with r/, 16 in another case, 24 another name such as 'one community' or a sister sub); ingest assigns the room from the dispatch folder, so no verdict moved; 3 lines carry an extra field agent. Story-miss rooms by room verdict: with-residue 13, composes 4 (placeDE, starcitizen, texans, hunterxhunter), split 1 (smashbros).

D2a section 3, the sampling rule, written before the draw. Ten model-D.md files, drawn by seed 20261016 with random.Random(seed).sample over each stratum's sorted rooms, stratified on the room verdict from verdicts-D.jsonl: composes (both readers), composes-with-residue (both), does-not-compose (both), cannot-tell (both), split (readers differ). Each stratum gets two rooms, or all of its rooms when it holds fewer; the remainder goes to the largest stratum. For each room I check, by script and then by reading the file whole: element ids cited where the model applies; [absent <id>] where it did not apply; [new: ...] where no element covers what the room did; every adapted element of the room's ledger lines named in the file (by count of the room's lines, never as a list); every claim with a concept citation from the room's own codes (citations resolved against the store); whether the prose reads as the room's organizing in the model's words or as a summary of the model; whether the grade's sentence names what the ledger names. Quotes carried into notes-D2.md go through cite.py. Script: _analysis/d2_sample.py.

D2a sample 1 of 10, wario (cannot-tell, both readers; 1 concept in the store): the room model cites P01, P02, R01 and P09 where one title shows a call and a design; every other element and arrow is [absent], each marked unobserved or not-testable with the reason; every claim cites c0001; the labeler restricts P09 (the attack reading needs the target shown as another party's work). Reads as the room in the model's words, bounded to one concept. No title line. Grade with-residue.

D2a sample 2 of 10, Lugarix (cannot-tell, both readers): announcement titles and one reply; P11 instantiated, every other element [absent] with its evidence state; the labeler challenges a placement (the in-joke theme claims a history the quote does not show) and keeps the joke as an add-step inside P11; it resolves a P15 boundary locally (an approving reply to an announcement is P11, not the answer to a call). All citations resolve. Grade with-residue.

D2a sample 3 of 10, signal (composes, both readers): call, building report, design guidance and credit cited as P01, P03, P04, P02, P11, P12; one [new: dismissing an automatic mention notice], which marks a member's reply to a bot, not organizing; the labeler splits a theme placed whole under celebration across five elements. Some D08 arrow lines sit under Local exceptions. Grade with-residue.

D2a sample 4 of 10, uva (composes, both readers): a rich room read in the model's words with forest transitions and minutes; the labeler restricts A11 (the template was posted before the disagreement ended), A05 (an agreement recognised an intention already held: the member writes that they had no plans to continue below that border, 'maybe others did', uva/c0021) and A21; adds a step to P03 (discovering a second mark); uses candidates P06, R02, K04 as the candidates. Readers say composes; the labeler grades with-residue on these local adaptations.

D2a sample 5 of 10, quebec (composes-with-residue, both readers): national framing, alliances, scripts, a host's sticky rule; the labeler restricts A11 (scripts defended an obsolete design), A12 (a bare refusal), A05 (restraint for a memorial), A09; instantiates C01 locally (a vote and a declared strategy, not obeyed room-wide); six [new:] markers, of which moving deliberation into live chat and returning political questions to the room are practices, while 'unresolved title-only residue' and 'unresolved recollection' use [new:] as a residue tag. Candidates K03, K04, P06, R02 instantiated.

D2a sample 6 of 10, flashtv (composes-with-residue, both readers): loss and restart, kinship restraint, a host closure prank; the labeler restricts A11, A01, A02, A10 and A05; eight [new:] markers: reusing pixels while relocating, rebuilding after a move and learning a neighbour's design to stop mistaken repair are organizing; invoking a conversational bot and sympathetic conversation are not. Candidates P06, P19, R02, K04 instantiated. Grade with-residue.

D2a sample 7 of 10, minnesotavikings (composes-with-residue, both readers): truces with Packers, Raptors alliance, scripts, a megathread rule; the labeler instantiates the tentative P21 in bounded form (a member says they cannot force people to do anything, minnesotavikings/c0254) and A21; instantiates C01 locally (division of work, a vote on the bot); restricts A11 and A05; five [new:] practices, all organizing (decisions relayed through chat and a script setter; restraint translated into script targets). It corrects its own case account's attribution of one complaint. Grade with-residue.

D2a sample 8 of 10, picturegame (does-not-compose, both readers; the only such room): a guessing-game sub with one emoji proposal that names the canvas; the labeler keeps the room inside the model's terms, K01 (an April Fools sound round) and P13 (the proposal), with every canvas element unobserved; [new: making a sound-only round playable with a picture hint] is a local practice of the game, and [new: carrying on ordinary sub talk] repeats T3-017, which the vocabulary holds. Readers: the room's organizing is not canvas organizing; labeler: with-residue.

D2a sample 9 of 10, aggies (split: with-residue and composes): a full campaign; the labeler folds R01 and P01 into one act (A02), restricts A11 and A08 (a screenshot requested before completion), adds conditions to P14 (an honor code against scripts), A13 and A19 (help bought from former attackers); C01 locally (an organiser decides and defers); [new: allocating repair effort among several valued works] is organizing, [new: holding playful moderators accountable to their role] is host conduct. Candidates K03, K04, R02 instantiated.
